g.text: Scikit-Mobility 2 - Generalized Architecture Workflow for Individual Metrics

text.tspan: (Converts input to Narwhals eager format; validates and casts coordinates.)
(Inspects backend Arrow/NumPy and assigns the correct optimized function dictionary.)
(Finds slice boundaries using shift/masks for pre-grouped and pre-sorted data.)
(Maps user IDs to contiguous integers to prepare for Rust-based parallel indexing.)
(Uses Rayon to slice indices by user and parallel-sort by timestamp. Returns Ends & Indices.)
(Executes core algorithm linearly across pre-sliced ranges.)
(Executes core algorithm traversing raw arrays via the temporal index map.)
(Applies final aggregations and casts back to native Pandas/Polars.)
